name: tmem

devices.b300: sm_103a, (tcgen05 is sm_100-class only; no h100 cell)

purpose: b300 LDTM 32x32b.x128 issue_interval_cycles is placeholder 0 (placeholder.p0) while every other 32x32b shape carries a measured interval (x1..x32 mechtree.w5.tmem_ii, x64 32.0 mechtree.w8.tmem2.ld_thru). blackwell-prototype could not measure x128 because a warp holding one x128 destination (128 registers) cannot hold a second, so its one-warp ld_thru window had no slope. Corpus: 464 executed LDTM x128 warp instructions in 22 of 450 single-cluster blackwell cases ($A/diag/mb4/dyncount-bw.tsv).
engine_semantics: LDTM service leaf resource = issue_frontend_smsp (one unit per SMSP); the issue interval is charged per instruction on the issuing warp's SMSP, so warps sharing an SMSP serialise on it. mechtree.w5.tmem_ii states the warpgroup run kept the one-warp interval (per-SMSP path).
probe: new tools/microbench/tmem/probe/ldtm_warps.cu (shapes from service_latency/probe/tmem_ops.cuh, verbatim structs Tm_32x32b_x32 / x64 / x128): one CTA of 4 x N warps (N in {1, 2, 4, 8}); warp 0 allocates 128 TMEM columns (tcgen05.alloc, relinquish) and writes them once with tcgen05.st + wait::st; only warps with warp_id % 4 == 0 (the N warps of SMSP 0, all addressing TMEM lane quadrant 0) take part in the timed region, the others park at the final barrier. Per rep: bar.sync of all warps; jitter-free start (all participants leave the barrier together); each participant: t_s = clock64; one tcgen05.ld.sync.aligned.32x32b.<shape>.b32 into its own registers at column 0; tcgen05.wait::ld; t_e = clock64; registers folded into a sink after t_e. Per rep the window is max over participants of t_e minus min over participants of t_s (same SM clock). Shapes x128 (target), x64 and x32 (controls). --launches 8 --reps 33 (rep 0 of each launch dropped, launch 0 dropped), two runs.
sass_gate: per kernel (shape, N): between each participant's two clock reads exactly 1 LDTM of the expected shape (x128 / x64 / x32 as printed by cuobjdump) plus the tcgen05.wait::ld form; no other instruction class inside the window that scales with N (the window code is identical for every N, only the CTA size changes); 0 kernels found = gate failure.
derivation: E(shape, N) = median over launches of the per-launch median window. issue_interval(shape) = OLS slope of E over N in {1, 2, 4, 8}.
acceptance: controls first: the x64 slope must reproduce the installed 32.0 within 10 % and the x32 slope the installed 16.0 within 10 % on both runs; if either control fails nothing is installed (the method does not reproduce the per-SMSP interval) and x128 is recorded unrealised:control. With the controls passing: x128 OLS max relative residual <= 5 % and run agreement <= 5 % -> measured; otherwise experimental if run agreement <= 10 %, else unrealised.
install: b300 instruction.service LDTM tmem_shape x128 issue_interval_cycles <- x128 slope, source tmem.b300.<run> (artifact $A/microbench/tmem/b300-<run>/, model $A/microbench/tmem-model/b300-<run>/model.json); result / completion stay structural.v10.tmem_result_row; resource unchanged. The controls are cited in the source description, their leaves untouched. A/B 500 x 2 single-cluster against the current main baseline.
not_allowed: no case-cycle tuning; no values from other machines; no threshold or derivation change after data

addenda.before_run: b300-r2 (written after the full-GPU 500 attribution of TRF-TUT-GROUP-GEMM-PTR-C01 `missing_fact:program:instruction.service (LDTM; none)`; before any probe change, build or launch)
addenda.cell: 16x32bx2 load x64 (SASS LDTM.16dp32bit_t0_t15.x64 + LDTM.16dp32bit_t16_t31.x64 per PTX op)
addenda.text: (1) Gap: b300 instruction.service LDTM tmem_shape 16dp32bit has issue_interval points for tmem_repeat x1..x32 and blackwell.tmem.load has cycles for the same repeats (source mechtree.tmem.16x32bx2, blackwell-prototype run tmem-16x32bx2-r1); load x64 is absent because that probe's ld_thru K series was gated on NR x K <= 64 registers (tmem_ldst.cu: NR*8 <= 64 -> K {1,2,4,8}; NR*4 <= 64 -> {1,2,4}; NR*2 <= 64 -> {1,2}; x64 has NR = 64 and got none). The register file allows a one-warp window with K = 3 back-to-back x64 loads (192 destination registers + addressing < 255), so the slope over K is measurable with the original one-warp method; the multi-warp method of this protocol's body is not used for this cell (it failed its controls in r1). (2) Probe: port blackwell-prototype tools/microbench/probes/tmem_ldst.cu's ld_wc and ld_thru kernels verbatim into tools/microbench/tmem/probe/tmem_ldst_x64.cu (shapes from service_latency/probe/tmem_ops.cuh Tm_16x32bx2_x64 / x32 / x16 and Tm_32x32b_x32 / x16), one warp, ld_wc: U in {1, 2, 4, 8} chained {tcgen05.ld; tcgen05.wait::ld; consume}; ld_thru: K distinct-register back-to-back tcgen05.ld then one tcgen05.wait::ld, with K in {1, 2, 3} for 16x32bx2.x64 and the original series for the controls (16x32bx2.x16 / x32, 32x32b.x16 / x32); immHalfSplitoff = the shape's width in columns as in the original protocol; --launches 16 --reps 65; two runs on one B300 (same-run controls replace the two-GPU rule of the original protocol, which had two GPUs available). (3) SASS gate: per kernel the timed window holds exactly 2 K (ld_thru) or 2 U (ld_wc) LDTM of spelling 16dp32bit_t0_t15 / 16dp32bit_t16_t31 with .x64 (or the control shape), plus the wait::ld form, no other LDTM/STTM; 0 kernels found = gate failure. (4) Derivation (unchanged from the original protocol): S = slope of ld_wc over U (cycles per PTX op), T = slope of ld_thru over K; I = T / 2 per SASS instruction, C = S - T / 2. For x64 T is the OLS slope over K in {1, 2, 3}. (5) Acceptance: controls first — in both runs the 16x32bx2 x16 / x32 I must reproduce the installed 8.17857 / 16.0 and the 32x32b x16 / x32 I the installed 8.357 / 16.0 within 10 %, and C within 10 % of the installed blackwell.tmem.load cycles; if any control fails nothing is installed and x64 is recorded unrealised:control. With the controls passing: x64 ld_thru OLS max relative residual <= 5 %, S > T, run agreement of I and C <= 5 % -> measured; run agreement <= 10 % -> experimental; else unrealised. (6) Install: b300 instruction.service LDTM / tmem_shape 16dp32bit / tmem_repeat x64: issue_interval_cycles <- I (result / completion / resource as the x32 sibling: structural.v10.tmem_result_row, issue_frontend_smsp); blackwell.tmem.load 16dp32bit / x64: cycles <- C; source key tmem.b300.r2.x64 (+ .experimental) with run, GPU, date; cyclescope tree build && tree validate --strict five classes 0. The controls' leaves are untouched. A/B: single-cluster 500 x 2 bw against the current treatment arm (TRF-TUT-GROUP-GEMM-PTR-C01 must leave missing_fact; other cases unchanged) and the full-GPU case.
addenda.not_allowed: no value extrapolated from x32 (the x1..x32 series is not a model, the protocol installs measured points only); no multi-warp substitute; no threshold or derivation change after data
